references.context: Hit the center drop-target bank, right-side rollover lane, and hole kicker while their MVP-cup inserts are lit.
references.label: Center drop-target bank
references.description: The center bank collects lit MVP-cup inserts; its upper target scores the MVP awards.

references.context: Hit the center drop-target bank, right-side rollover lane, and hole kicker while their MVP-cup inserts are lit.
references.label: Right-side rollover lane
references.description: The rollover lane at the right side collects its lit MVP-cup insert.

references.context: Hit the center drop-target bank, right-side rollover lane, and hole kicker while their MVP-cup inserts are lit.
references.label: Hole kicker
references.description: The hole kicker collects its lit MVP-cup insert.

references.context: Shoot the basket once during single-ball play to light regular Multiball at the right ramp. Leave the ramp uncollected.
references.label: Basket
references.description: The moving hoop above the center playfield qualifies Multiball and scores its Jackpots.

references.context: If all four events and regular Multiball are ready before ball 3, shoot the right ramp immediately. On ball 3, shoot the ramp with whatever features are waiting.
references.label: Start and lock ramp
references.description: The right ramp starts qualified events and Multiball and temporarily holds balls during relocks.

references.context: Throughout the stack, shoot the center Drop Target for MVP, the vari-target for the Game Balls event, and the basket for Shot Clock. When the event timer gets low, shoot the HORSE spinner to restart it.
references.label: HORSE spinner
references.description: The spinner controls HORSE progress and keeps the stacked event timers running.

references.context: When SHAQUILLE is complete, shoot Tip-Off and select Slammin Jammin to start the three-ball feature.
references.label: Tip-Off left up-kicker
references.description: The left up-kicker gives choice awards and starts qualified Slammin Jammin.

references.context: Throughout the stack, shoot the center Drop Target for MVP, the vari-target for the Game Balls event, and the basket for Shot Clock. When the event timer gets low, shoot the HORSE spinner to restart it.
references.label: Vari-target
references.description: The lower-left vari-target advances the Game Balls event.

references.context: Throughout the stack, shoot the center Drop Target for MVP, the vari-target for the Game Balls event, and the basket for Shot Clock. When the event timer gets low, shoot the HORSE spinner to restart it.
references.label: Center Drop Target
references.description: The upper-playfield drop target is the priority MVP shot.

references.context: Shoot 1, 2, 3, and 4 in order to light #5, then let the ball enter the right up-kicker. It awards Game Ball 14 and immediately opens the trade prompt.
references.label: Right up-kicker
references.description: The up-kicker between the upper flippers collects lit #5 and opens the Game Ball trade.
